name: realtime-feature-flags
description: Multi-tenant feature flags: a NestJS API, an SSE stream to an SDK that evaluates flags locally, and a Next.js dashboard.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run check:claims && npm run check:words
